archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) adapted for Minimal Video Platform

global_rules.emotion: Clean, focused, premium, and distraction-free. The content is king.
global_rules.spacing_philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-6, p-8, and p-12 extensively to let video thumbnails breathe.
global_rules.borders_and_shadows: Minimal to zero borders on video thumbnails. Use proximity and negative space for grouping. Minimal player chrome.

fonts.heading: 'Space Grotesk', 'Comic Neue', sans-serif
fonts.instructions: User requested 'Cosmic Sans font (cosmic-vibe)'. Add a <link> to Google fonts for 'Space Grotesk' (for cosmic/tech vibe headings) and 'Outfit' (for clean body text).

rules.paywall: Highlight premium/paywall actions with 'primary_cta' (Red) or 'premium_accent' (Gold) to signify locked states.
rules.text_contrast: Ensure pure high contrast. Background pure white, text deep black.

layout_and_components.navigation: Sticky left sidebar on desktop (w-64), bottom bar or hamburger on mobile. Must include Logo, Discover, Following, Subscription, Profile.
layout_and_components.video_feed: Grid layout. grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8. No card wrappers for videos, just the thumbnail and text underneath.
layout_and_components.video_player: Massive width (max-w-5xl), border-radius rounded-xl. Controls hidden when not hovering. Ad-free, clean UI.
layout_and_components.paywall_overlay: Backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40) covering the video player or upload area for non-subscribers. Must have a clear CTA button to Subscribe for $0.99.
layout_and_components.buttons: Shadcn components heavily customized. Flat solid backgrounds, no soft shadows. Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-lg).
layout_and_components.forms: Use Shadcn forms for Auth and Uploads. High contrast focus rings.

animations.hover: -translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-200 ease-out on video thumbnails.
animations.page_transition: Simple opacity fade. Do not over-animate.
animations.player: Smooth fade-in for video controls on hover.

image_urls.description: Avatar portraits for users in the feed and comments
Placeholder thumbnails for the video feed and related videos

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Generate/Edit .js files only, NOT .tsx files.
Use Shadcn UI for standard components but heavily customize the look to fit the minimal light theme.
Ensure 'Stripe' paywall blocks the video player and upload page with a glassmorphic overlay for non-subscribers ($0.99/month).
Video Feed must look clean like a minimal YouTube. No borders around video cards, just thumbnail image and text underneath.
Add 'Space Grotesk' via Google Fonts for the 'Cosmic' typography vibe as requested by user.
Implement Cloudinary for native uploads. Build the Upload page explicitly.
Never use placeholders. Use the provided image URLs in the media section for seeding or dummy data.
